map_info.description: The principle map of facade_assembly. A small dense room where each of the six compositional moves — column orders, bay rhythm, hierarchy, fenestration, rustication, cornice/base — has a labeled tile underfoot. Pass-1 skeleton: spawn, teleporter, six marker tiles. Real principle-vocabulary artifacts authored in pass-2.

learning_objectives: Cornice/base as framing of the composition

documentation.summary: Facade_Assembly_Principle — the rulebook map of the facade_assembly branch.
documentation.layout: 8x6 walkable room. Spawn at the back row centre. Teleporter at the front row centre. Six exemplar tiles along the side rows, each marking one of the principle's six moves: column orders, bay rhythm, hierarchy, fenestration, rustication, cornice/base.
documentation.objective: Name the six compositional moves before the player walks the six expression maps.
